subject: Final onboarding: LumaPay bank activation + invoice remap instructions
messages:
From: LumaPay Onboarding <ops@lumapay.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: LumaPay Finance <payables@lumapay.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LumaPay banking packet + remittance formatting

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the warm welcome. Attached are the vendor documents you asked for: a signed bank letter with routing/account details, a redacted W-9, and a copy of our electronic vendor agreement (DocuSign).

Banking details (for your intake form) — prefer ACH (CCD) when available; fallback to wire only for urgent same-day payments:
- Bank: Harbor National Bank
- Routing: 111000025
- Account: 987654321
- Account name: LumaPay Inc.

Remittance: we can accept a structured remittance field. Preferred payload is a short free-text "invoice_ref" that contains the Redwood PO number and invoice number, e.g. "PO12345 | INV-2028-0021". If you have specific invoice-labeling rules for invoices delivered to your AR system, let us know and we will mirror them.

We also included a sample ACH test file (in the bank letter) and a scan of the bank authorization. Please confirm whether you require micro-deposits or a bank letter is sufficient for your finance team.

Attachments: LumaPay_Bank_Letter_03-2028.pdf (bank authorization), LumaPay_W9_2028_redacted.pdf, Vendor_Agreement_Link (DocuSign).

Best,
Selena Ortiz
Onboarding Ops | LumaPay
ops@lumapay.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: LumaPay Onboarding <ops@lumapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumaPay banking packet + remittance formatting

Thanks Selena — got the attachments, appreciated. Quick clarifications from our side so we can move to finance intake today: 

1) Micro-deposit vs bank letter: Our finance onboarding prefers two micro-deposits for standard ACH enrollments; accepting a bank letter is allowed for expedited setup but requires an escalation and an ACH test file. Can you confirm whether your bank supports micro-deposits to the account above? If yes, we'll schedule the micro-deposits Wednesday morning PST and expect confirmation the same day.

2) Remittance mapping: Our PO string pattern is PO-<6 digits> on all Redwood-issued POs (example: PO-004321). Can your team include that exact string in the invoice_ref field? If so we will ensure our AP parser extracts it into invoice_ref. If you prefer to echo our PO as a separate structured field, we can add an additional "po_number" attribute in the ACH metadata — let us know which you'd prefer.

3) W-9: thank you for the redacted copy. Our tax team will want the full copy on file — can you upload that to the DocuSign envelope or reply with the full W-9 to payables@redwood.com (we treat these as secure).

Next steps from our side: Jordan will kick off the vendor intake ticket with Finance once we confirm micro-deposit approach; if micro-deposits are OK we'll land the payee by Friday and ask Marissa to tag the account with "LumaPay - PO mapping: invoice_ref" in the vendor portal.

If you prefer a short call to walk the finance team through the remittance fields, I can schedule 15 minutes.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Vendor Enablement | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com

From: LumaPay Finance <payables@lumapay.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: LumaPay Onboarding <ops@lumapay.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumaPay banking packet + remittance formatting

Hi Ava —

Confirming: we can accept micro-deposits. We will authorize micro-deposits to arrive on Wed 03/07 (EST) and will reply to confirm the exact amounts. We can also provide an ACH test file on request after the micro-deposits clear.

Regarding invoice labeling: we will include both the free-text invoice_ref (example: "PO-004321 | INV-2028-0021") and a structured po_number field when we generate invoices. That should be compatible with Redwood's parser.

Full W-9: attached to the DocuSign envelope now (Vendor_Agreement_Link). You should see the completed W-9 there; let us know if your tax team needs anything else.

DocuSign reference: https://app.docusign.com/transaction/abc123-LumaPay-vendor

Thanks — will follow up after micro-deposit post.

Best,
Hector Rivera
Finance Manager | LumaPay
payables@lumapay.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, LumaPay Finance <payables@lumapay.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Mar 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumaPay banking packet + remittance formatting

All — quick update: micro-deposits posted this morning and LumaPay confirmed the amounts ("0.12 USD" and "0.29 USD"). Finance has validated the account and created vendor record LP-000987 in the vendor portal. 

Marissa: please set payment routing to ACH (Harbor National Bank / routing 111000025 / acct ****4321) and apply the vendor tag "LumaPay — invoice_ref PO mapping". Also enable CCD processing on Redwood's side and add a validation rule that extracts the first token matching regex PO-\d{6} from invoice_ref into our PO field. I attached our internal vendor intake snapshot for reference.

@LumaPay: once your first invoice is ready please include the invoice_ref with the PO exactly as discussed (e.g. "PO-004321 | INV-2028-0021") so the parser can reconcile automatically. If you need the exact layout for the ACH file we can provide the template.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_intake_snapshot_03-07.pdf

Thanks everyone — closing the intake after first invoice clears.

Jordan Blake
Sr. FinOps Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
